images.title: A line never ends
images.purpose: Show that a line goes on forever both ways, so we draw a part with arrows at both ends.
images.composition: One long horizontal line with an arrowhead at each end, a short segment highlighted in the middle.
images.exact_structure: One long horizontal grey #6B7280 line with an arrowhead at each end. In its middle, one short teal #0072B2 stretch with a dot at each end labelled A and B. Exactly 1 line, 2 arrowheads, 1 highlighted segment, 2 dots.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a line drawn with end dots instead of arrowheads
images.takeaway: Arrowheads show the line continues without end.
images.description: A long grey line with arrowheads at both ends and a short teal part between points A and B.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the arrowheads and say what they mean.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
